Erodium.



Erodium cicutarium. Hemlock Stork's Bill. N. O. Geraniaceæ. Decoction
        (half ounce of the herb to six ounces of water). Tincture of fresh plant.



Clinical. ─   Hæmorrhages. Uterine polypus.



Characteristics. ─     Erodium
        is a popular hæmostatic remedy in Russia, and is especially used for metrorrhagia and
        menorrhagia. Komorowitch cured with it numbers of cases in which   Ergot
        and   Hydrastis   had failed. One was a case of cervical
        polypus. After three days' use of the decoction the polypus was found lying free in the
        vagina. Compare   Geran. m  .
